headline: Monterey City Council election financial disclosures show Vicki Nohrden campaign leading in fundraising efforts.
summary: In the recent campaign finance disclosure filings for candidates in the race for two seats on the Monterey City Council—Districts 1 and 2—the campaign for District 2 candidate Vicki Nohrden has outraised all others with about $17,400 in contributions from…
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
